answer: Make every new agent enter through a sponsor who locks a bond that doubles with each agent they have already vouched for: the first costs 1 token, the tenth 512. A sybil farmer trying to plant a whole garden of fake identities soon faces a tundra of frozen capital, and any fraud by a sponsee slashes the sponsor's bonds. Honest agents vouch for a few peers, cheap as a sonnet; mass forgery becomes ruinous.
